title: Veterans Day: MRE Inspired Meals!
description:
Forget the powdered eggs and mystery meat. We're serving up some serious chow this Veterans Day!

Join us at Aviator Brewing Company in Fuquay-Varina for four military-inspired meals made with real Southern comfort food.

THE INFANTRYMAN'S MEATLOAF MRE | $17.76
Smoked meatloaf topped with brown gravy, mashed potatoes, green beans, a warm dinner roll, and a brownie.

THE GRUNT'S BBQ MRE | $16.95
Slow-smoked pulled pork BBQ, creamy mac & cheese, baked beans, cornbread, and a cookie.

THE TANK COMMANDER'S CHICKEN MRE | $17.95
Crispy country-fried chicken smothered in pepper gravy, mashed potatoes, Southern collard greens, and a warm biscuit.

THE GENERAL'S STEAK MRE | $24.95
Grilled sirloin steak, garlic mashed potatoes, seasoned green beans, and a slice of chocolate cake.

THANK YOU FOR YOUR SERVICE!

MEALS READY TO ENJOY!

Veteran-Owned. Veteran-Proud. American-Brewed. 🇺🇸🍺
